name: mirage
text: Yes, from the GitHub side: the NCAAB log workflow ran at 06:49 UTC today (and 22:58, 16:27 and 06:50 UTC yesterday, about every 3-8 hours). Each run pulls finished games and closing lines from ESPN, then refreshes each team's points per game, its against-the-spread record (the ++ / -- marks) and today's slate on the ncaab-data branch. The app reads those files whenever the NCAAB tab is open. What I have not verified is what your phone currently shows, so check that the ratings on the tab are dated today; if they're older, pull to refresh there and tell me.
